answer: Vouch-slot bond: each identity may vouch for three newcomers per epoch, locking 40 credit plus 15 fee, each vouch sealed with a velvet stamp in the harbor roll. A fake vouchee burns the sponsor's 40 bond and voids its slots; the harbor ledger names rented sponsors. Each fake costs 55, so 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and cost 55,000, above a 40,000 pool. An honest sponsor pays 55 once and recovers it after one clean epoch, keeping ivory proof.
